| _and_ Treia (MC), Contrada Chiaravalle 49, Villa Luzi Votalarca |
| _Date:_ 391 |
| _Edition(s):_ ICVR II, 6050; AE, |
| 1987, 61 ; Paci 1985, |
| 542-544 ; Marinucci 1991, |
| 104-105, n. 26 ; AE, |
| 1991, 361 Online: EDR31373 |
|  |
| [anteprima](https://www.edb.uniba.it/images/watermark/5c0d43ff85e4e_6050_watermark.png) |
|  |
|  |
| ⌜P⌝etili{li}ano benemerenti in pace qui vixsis ((vas)) |
| annus n̅(umero) L[X]V d(epositus) in pacem V idus maias Tatiano et Symmaco con̅s̅(ulibu)s̅ |
|  |
| Transcription different from ICVR. I on stone. The left fragment, considered lost by Silvagni in ICVR edition, is in Villa Luzi Votalarca (Contrada Chiaravalle 49, Treia (MC): cf. Paci 1985. The right part, in the Lapidario at Ostia Antica, has been mistakenly considered an unedited inscription from Ostia (Marinucci). The EDR record (EDR031373) has Trismegistos Number 253095. Many thanks to Silvia Orlandi who noticed to me the correspondence between the two records into EDB and EDR (A.E. Felle). |
|  |
| Carlo Carletti, 11/11/2003 |
| Last update by Antonio Enrico Felle on 09/12/2018 |
